v4_result_bounded.ranking: Q1 best; constrained readouts WORSE than Q1 by 3.88%-5.52%; among constrained L64_Q32 closest to Q1, then ENDPOINT_N32 < DELTA_N32 < L32.
v4_result_bounded.interpretation: Q1 and all four constrained models improve in absolute DEV MSE with more CAL rows; Q1 improves most; free-linear worsens (overfit). source_density_delta (delta r) measures gap-to-Q1 change, not absolute effectiveness.
v4_result_bounded.mechanism_bounds: Free uses Q1 base, constrained use Q0 base (base confound); L64 matched-capacity linear beats ENDPOINT_N32 on 11/11 sources (capacity confound). No causal endpoint-information or degrees-of-freedom-overfit claim supported.

doc_rev2_corrections.floor: Published floor = mean_CAL ||BF16_replay_prediction - gated_dense_target||^2/(n*D) = total replay-vs-dense error (model + rounding), NOT pure BF16 rounding noise. floor/R_Q1,CAL in [0.99936,1.00043]. The 11/11 q1_denominator_below_floor flag is an artifact of this inflated floor; 'unmeasurable' claim RETRACTED as stated. Correct rounding floor = ||BF16_replay - FP32_math_prediction||^2; recompute pending V4D/correction scope.
